verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page states you can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow' alongside Zapier, and its scanned mail is stored as cloud PDFs, so a first-party API plausibly covers mail data. However, no evidence shows API endpoints, reference docs or authentication details, and probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs. Missing for 10: documented endpoints for listing mail items, documented scan/PDF download via the API, public API reference documentation, a machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
